name: The Lodestone Face
description: An exposed core, and the only place the ore can be worked.
arrival: A wound in the island's flank where something took a bite out of it, and the rock inside is black and faintly wrong. Grit stands on end where it has fallen. A dropped knife does not lie flat.
notes: Where lodestone grit comes from, and the map's one `never`-renewing material. The island is held up by this: taking it is the closest the game comes to asking whether a thing should be taken at all, and nothing in the text says so out loud.
